structural.reference_uncertain_rule: Top1 or epsilon-set membership changes 1500->3000, or any nonbest policy has epsilon boundary distance <3 paired-gap MCSE. No expansion. Top3 stability separately reported.
structural.capacity_rounding: Decimal round-half-to-even of exact decimal multiplier 0.9 or 1.1 times prespecified integer
structural.booking_rule: w*exp(sign*0.35*s), s=(-1,-.6,-.2,.2,.6,1), sign=-1 EARLY/+1 LATE; normalize to original total mass

non_gaussian.ON: independent common and idiosyncratic components; shared common component across policies
non_gaussian.OFF: each policy has independent common-component copy and independent idiosyncratic component; same marginal convolution as ON

intervals.EOC: Student-t 95%; ddof=1 MCSE; zero observed variance yields descriptive degenerate interval, not population certainty
intervals.contrasts: independent Newcombe-Wilson for proportions; independent Welch for EOC/nEOC. Reused baseline dependence across contrasts explicitly acknowledged; no pooled independent treatment.
intervals.synthetic_errors: Clopper-Pearson two-sided 95% and one-sided 95% upper bound
intervals.reference: paired-gap MCSE vs plug-in best, precision diagnostic not selective-inference guarantee

classification.scenario_structurally_sensitive: CPC preservation Wilson upper < .95 in either mode, or CPC-v2 minus SH OFF nEOC Welch upper < 0, or ON minus OFF CPC mean eliminated Welch upper < 0
classification.scenario_moderately_sensitive: Absent structural trigger: any absolute delta PGS >= .10 or absolute delta nEOC >= .001 vs matching formal baseline, any CPC preservation point <.95, or reference_uncertain
classification.scenario_stable: No structural or moderate trigger; descriptive, not invariance proof
classification.overall_limited: At least 3 structurally sensitive scenarios, or any CPC preservation point <.90, or any non-Gaussian false-elimination two-sided CP lower >.05
classification.overall_strong: At least 6 stable scenarios, zero structurally sensitive scenarios, no uncertain structural reference, and all non-Gaussian observed false-elimination <=.05
classification.threshold_scope: Predefined descriptive reporting rules, not engineering gates or new theoretical guarantees; all individual results and CIs shown
